# Exemptions from the file-size rule (AGENTS.md; checked by scripts/check-file-size, docs/ci.md).
# One entry per line: <path or glob> <reason>. A glob's * also matches /. An entry without a
# reason exempts nothing. Generated files (a `@generated` or `DO NOT EDIT` marker in their first
# five lines) need no entry. The health pass reviews this list.
docs/briefs/*.html design mockups, self-contained by rule so they cannot be split (0026)
docs/design/*.html design mockups, self-contained by rule so they cannot be split (docs/briefs/README.md)
packages/ui/ui.css the one shared stylesheet of every page and the organiser shell (docs/design/mockups.html); its sections share tokens and the cascade layer, so splitting it would make every page load several files
